messages:
Gabe: Heads-up 6C Cascade Labs' renewal INV-97531 has the platform fee split across two currency lines (USD + EUR). AR mapping rejects because contract AMND-2024-03 specifies a single USD platform fee. Help? :confused:
Tara: Can you paste the export? Curious whether this is a currency conversion issue or two separate charge types.
Gabe: Export snippet from billing export:
- PLATFORM_FEE  80,000.00 USD  GL:PLAT-0100
- PLATFORM_FEE  35,000.00 EUR  GL:PLAT-0100-EU
Total shows as mixed currencies. Contract states Platform Fee = 120,000 USD (customer paid 20,000 EUR prepayment earlier in FY which our portal tagged as local-currency payment).
Win: Looks like the prepayment pipeline created a local-currency settlement line that billing exported as a separate invoice line instead of netting into the single USD platform fee. AR expects one line and one currency to auto-match. Two remediation paths: 1) Issue credit CM-634 to void the EUR line and reissue INV-97531-R1 in USD with a memo referencing the prepayment; 2) Post a clearing journal to offset EUR prepayment into USD AR and leave invoice, but customer's AP wants USD single-line.
accounts-bot: Invoice INV-97531 created at 2087654315 by billing-worker. Status: Pending. Payment note: partial prepayment in EUR detected.
Tara: Customer asked for minimal docs. They prefer a single USD invoice so their treasury team doesn't have to run FX matching. So option 1. We need tax and FX sign-off because reversing a EUR line can create realized FX differences.
Fiona: I own Cascade. Confirmed with customer's AP on a quick call. They will accept a reissued USD invoice that references the EUR prepayment (they want the prepayment to show in memo). Please preserve original invoice date in memo.
tax-bot: Note: reversing a EUR line is OK. Ensure memo includes original EUR amount, payment reference PX-4499, and file PR-8241 for reconciliation. Record any FX realized gain/loss in PR-8241.
Win: Proposed steps: 1) Create credit memo CM-634 to void EUR line 2) Reissue INV-97531-R1 with single PLATFORM_FEE 120,000 USD and memo: "Consolidated per AMND-2024-03. Prepayment 20,000 EUR ref PX-4499. See PR-8241." 3) Post PR-8241 to record FX booking and link CM-634 + new invoice. ETA 1 business day.
accounts-bot: Credit memo CM-634 created at 2087654400 by billing-worker.
Win: PR-8241 posted at 2087654525 linking CM-634 and INV-97531-R1. Journal recorded EUR prepayment reclassification and FX realized loss of 1,200 USD to PR-8241 as narrative.
Win: INV-97531-R1 issued at 2087654550. Memo: "Consolidated per AMND-2024-03. Prepayment 20,000 EUR (PX-4499). Ref: INV-97531. See PR-8241." Emailed to ap@cascadelabs.example.
accounts-bot: AR ingest processed at 2087654620. Status: Success.
Tara: AR upload succeeded on our side. Cascade confirmed they matched the reissue and will release payment. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
Gabe: I'll file a short action item for eng-billing: prevent emitting separate local-currency prepayment lines when contract currency is USD. Filing FR-9620.
Fiona: Thanks all. I'll close the renewal ticket once payment processes.
